steps.text: Open Safari (not the Spotify app) and go to your Spotify account page. Log in if it asks.
On 'How you listen will change', tap 'Continue to cancel'.
Tap 'Yes, cancel'. You keep Premium until your next bill date.
Open Safari and go to claude.ai. Log in if it asks.
Scroll to the bottom. Under 'Cancellation', tap 'Cancel'.
Tap 'Cancel plan'. You keep Pro until the end of this billing period.
Open Safari and go to your Google Account. Log in if it asks.
Tap 'Cancel subscription' again to confirm. You keep your plan until the end of this billing period.
Open Settings. Tap your name at the top, then 'Subscriptions'.
Scroll to the bottom and tap 'Cancel All Services'.
On 'Do you want to keep any services?', leave them all unticked and tap 'Cancel All Services'.
Tap 'Cancel Subscription'. A free trial ends right away.
